section_summary.extract_value: This section, presented as a note, explains that 'activities in daily living' was initially included as a health measure but was ultimately excluded from the final analyses due to a lack of significant associations with gratitude in preliminary analyses. The authors included this note for transparency.
section_summary.evidence_source: Note 1. Whereas activities in daily living were included as an additional measure of daily health, we did not find significant associations with gratitude in preliminary analyses. Thus, we ultimately decided to not include this measure in our final analyses and include here for the sake of transparency.
